measure.evidenceText: Google Hotels identifies Hotel Hacienda at 179 Cleveland St, Redfern NSW 2016, Sydney as a 3-star hotel. The result shows $61 nightly and $67 total for 1 night with taxes + fees, with a 2 Adults control. The returned evidence does not explicitly state one room.
measure.referencePeriod: Google Hotels result for 6–7 July 2026; 2 adults shown
measure.searchQuery: site:google.com/travel/hotels Sydney Australia 3-star hotel 2 adults nightly price taxes
measure.reason: A named exact-city 3-star property and two-adult price were returned, but the same evidence does not explicitly state one room. The strict contract forbids inferring one room from a two-adult control; no Expedia or Booking snippet supplied all required fields.
